title: Acid-modified Cu–Ce/HZSM-5 adsorbent removes trace phosphorus impurities from recycled hydrogen during polysilicon production
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,13799-13811
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01322D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Zhiyuan Liu, Guoqiang Huang
In this study, an acid-modified Cu–Ce/HZSM-5 bimetallic adsorbent was developed for the removal of trace PH3 impurities from simulated recycled hydrogen in a chemical vapor deposition furnace for polysilicon production.
